analysis.session_summary: USD dominated on a 165K vs 65K NFP beat, lifting USD/CAD +139.0 pips and EUR/USD -94.7 pips; JPY firmed to rank 2. UoM consumer sentiment beat 51.0 vs 48.1 but USD weakened 0.046%, an inverted reaction suggesting crowded longs. Late Iran de-escalation headlines trimmed USD gains and lifted risk FX. CAD jobs miss -4.7K vs 14.6K reinforced CAD weakness.

themes.evidence: USD strength_pct 0.807; USD/CAD +139.0 pips; EUR/USD -94.7 pips; USD/JPY +57.7 pips.

themes.theme: Inverted UoM signals stretched USD longs
themes.evidence: Prelim UoM actual 51.0 vs 48.1 produced USD weaker 0.046%, opposite textbook sign.
Iran source headline pushed EUR/USD +8.1 in 15 min (68% of move) and NZD/USD +6.4 in 15 min (47% of move).

currency_drivers.USD: Stronger on 165K NFP beat vs 65K; UoM beat inverted with USD weaker 0.046%.
currency_drivers.EUR: Lagarde no quotes; attempt to +0.07% rejected, gave back 67%.
currency_drivers.JPY: Firmed to close at its best; Ueda unscored, but JPY weakened 0.044% around the speech.
currency_drivers.GBP: No own releases; held range and weakened 0.179%.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own catalyst; weakest major at -0.482%.
currency_drivers.CAD: Employment miss -4.7K vs 14.6K weakened CAD 0.133%; other releases muted.
currency_drivers.CHF: No domestic catalyst; selling to -0.13% rejected, recovered 65%.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; weakened 0.455% with no clear catalyst.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: The tape is a dominant -104.3-pip slide tagged to Lagarde, then a small 11.9-pip bounce tied to Iran de-escalation headlines.

polarity_reads.read: 165K vs 65K beat triggered USD strength 0.157%; market was short USD into the print.
Beat to 51.0 vs 48.1 produced USD weakness 0.046%; inverted reaction implies long USD positioning is crowded.
-4.7K vs 14.6K miss weakened CAD 0.133%; CAD remains highly sensitive to jobs data.
JPY weakened 0.044% but no forecast exists to score the surprise; cannot assign direction.

scenarios.name: USD bid resumes
scenarios.thesis: Strong NFP beat and USD strength_pct 0.807 dominate; UoM inversion is treated as noise.
scenarios.invalidation: EUR/USD closes above 1.11448 or USD/JPY closes below 158.276 on UoM follow-through.

pair_paths.rationale: Replays the -94.7-pip daily slide as USD strength dominates.
CAD jobs miss keeps USD/CAD near its +139.0-pip daily gain.

scenarios.name: USD fade on inverted UoM
scenarios.thesis: UoM beat produced USD weakness 0.046%, signaling longs are crowded; late USD rally unwinds.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY closes back above 158.276 and EUR/USD below 1.11448.

pair_paths.rationale: Range high of 112.7 pips is the recovery target if USD longs unwind.
First USD/JPY down leg was -39.9 pips; fade targets that.
AUD/USD range of 99.2 pips offers recovery room if USD retreats.

scenarios.name: Risk-on de-escalation
scenarios.thesis: Late Iran source headlines boosted risk FX; if confirmed, AUD/NZD recover and USD loses haven support.
triggers: Iran nuclear proposal via Qatar confirmed

pair_paths.rationale: AUD/USD range 99.2 pips offers recovery if risk sentiment improves.
NZD/USD range 85.8 pips; late +13.7-pip bounce extends.
USD/JPY range 131.8 pips caps the pair if haven demand fades.

risks.why_it_matters: Inverted reaction to a sentiment beat shows long USD positioning is stretched and vulnerable to good news selling.
Late headline-driven risk recovery could reverse, restoring USD strength and hurting AUD/NZD.

risks.risk: CAD remains vulnerable to jobs data
risks.why_it_matters: CAD jobs miss drove USD/CAD to +139.0 pips; further weak data can extend CAD underperformance.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: NZD Parliamentary Elections at 22:45 (High) and BOE Gov Bailey Speaks at 18:25 (Medium) are the scheduled catalysts; headlines can still dominate.
